name: FrenchModelVariant178_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant178_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4, followed by a source-owned unit-scale vector; for a non-negative request it selects the descriptor indexed by the request and packs the textures, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-variant178.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-161/291 and Japanese images build the same source through model_variant/variant178_entry_usa.c, which adds the work-size printf, and bind its data names 0xC, 0x1C and 0x1C higher. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
